    &lt;style&gt;
        @page {
            size: A4;
            margin-top: 1.1in;
            margin-left: 0.45in;
            margin-right: 0.5in;
            margin-bottom: 1.3in;

            @top-left {
                content: element(decorationLeft);
                vertical-align: top;
                margin-top: 0.5in;
            }

            @top-right {
                content: element(decorationRight);
                vertical-align: top;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-top: 0.5in;
            }

            @bottom-left {
                content: element(mailFooter);
                vertical-align: bottom;
                margin-bottom: 0.3in;
            }

            @top-center {
                vertical-align: bottom;
            }
        }


        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .body-surat {
            width: 21cm;
            font-size: 12pt;
        }

        .header,
        .header-space {
            width: auto;
            height: 0.8in;
        }

        .footer,
        .footer-space {
            height: 135px;
        }

        @media print {

            .header,
            .footer {
                position: fixed;
            }
        }

        @media screen {
            body {
                position: relative;
            }

            .header,
            .footer {
                position: absolute;
            }

            hr.break-after {
                margin-bottom: 8rem;
            }
        }

        .header {
            top: 50;
            width: inherit;
            max-width: inherit;
        }

        .footer {
            bottom: 0;
            width: inherit;
            max-width: inherit;
            opacity: 0.75;
            line-height: 1;
            z-index: -1;
            left: 0.5in;
        }

        .footer-text {
            opacity: 0.5;
            font-size: 12pt;
        }

        .footer-body {
            font-size: 12pt;
        }

        .kop-logo {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0.5in;
            top: 0;
            width: 63px;
            height: 55px;
        }

        .kop-decoration {
            position: absolute;
            right: 0.5in;
            top: 0;
            width: 35px;
            height: 35px;
        }

        h1,
        h2,
        h3 {
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        b {
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        i {
            font-style: italic;
        }

        ol {
            list-style-type: decimal;
            padding-left: 0;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-right {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .text-justify {
            text-align: justify;
        }

        .border-top {
            border-top: 1px solid black;
        }

        .mx-auto {
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .mt-2 {
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
        }

        .mt-4 {
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        .mb-2 {
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .mb-4 {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .ml-4 {
            margin-left: 1rem;
        }

        .ml-8 {
            margin-left: 2rem;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            font-size: 12pt;
        }

        table tr {
            vertical-align: baseline;
        }

        .ol-lower-alpha {
            list-style-type: lower-alpha;
        }

        .pl-8 {
            padding-left: 2rem;
        }

        .pl-12 {
            padding-left: 3rem;
        }

        .pl-6 {
            padding-left: 1.5rem;
        }

        .pl-4 {
            padding-left: 1rem;
        }

        li+li {
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
        }

        table.td-gap-4 td {
            padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        #meta-surat {
            margin: 0 auto;
            max-width: 21rem;
        }

        hr.break-after {
            break-after: page;
            visibility: hidden;
        }

        .no-break-inside {
            break-inside: avoid;
        }

        .parent {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .signature-container {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 20px;
            max-width: 23rem;
            text-align: center;
        }

        #tanda-tangan {
            max-width: 23rem;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .underline {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        .content-receiver {
            text-align: left;
            margin-left: auto;

            word-wrap: break-word;
            display: block;
            max-width: 200px;


        }

        .letter-info {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            max-width: 400px;
        }

        .info-row {
            display: flex;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .info-label {
            flex: 0 0 76px;
            padding-right: 10px;
        }

        .info-content {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .content-letter {
            margin-top: 200px;
        }

        .watermark {
            position: fixed;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg);
            opacity: 0.13;
            font-size: 10em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: grey;
            z-index: -1;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-family: sans-serif;
        }

        .esign-place {
            width: 225px;
            height: 90px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .footer-title {
            font-size: 14pt;
        }

        .footer-office {
            font-size: 12pt;
        }

        .footer-body {
            font-size: 10pt;
        }

        @media print {
            .footer-space {
                height: 235px;
            }
        }


        .confidential-notice.show-on-last {
            display: block;
            text-align: justify;
            font-size: 10px;

            padding: 0px 0;

            line-height: 1.4;
            margin: 0;
            position: absolute;

            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
        }

        @media screen {
            .confidential-notice.show-on-last {
                display: none;
            }
        }

         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         

         

         
         
         
         
         
         

         
         
         
         
    &lt;/style&gt;
    &lt;script src=&quot;https://storage.googleapis.com/nde-bucket/pagedjs/paged.polyfill-v.0.2.js&quot;&gt;&lt;/script&gt;
    &lt;script&gt;
        class HandleLastPage extends Paged.Handler {
            constructor(chunker, polisher, caller) {
                super(chunker, polisher, caller);
            }

            afterRendered(pages) {
                const lastPage = pages[pages.length - 1];
                if (lastPage) {
                    
                    const footerSpace = lastPage.element.querySelector('.footer-space');
                    if (footerSpace) {
                        const notice = document.createElement('div');
                        notice.className = 'confidential-notice show-on-last';
                        notice.innerHTML = 'Dokumen ini dan informasi yang terkandung di dalamnya hanya dipergunakan untuk kepentingan internal PT Pos Indonesia (Persero) Setiap perbuatan atau tindakan, apapun cara dan bentuknya, yang mengakibatkan kandungan informasi tersebut diketahui oleh pihak-pihak yang tidak berhak dapat dikenai sanksi indisipliner dan/atau sanksi hukum.';

                        
                        footerSpace.parentNode.insertBefore(notice, footerSpace);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Paged.registerHandlers(HandleLastPage);
    &lt;/script&gt;
&lt;script type=&quot;text/javascript&quot;&gt;
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var height = Math.max(document.body.scrollHeight, document.body.offsetHeight);
      var width = Math.max(document.body.scrollWidth, document.body.offsetWidth);
  
      window.top.postMessage(
        {
          type: &quot;size-whisperer&quot;,
          tag: &quot;main&quot;,
          height: height,
          width: width
        },
        '*'
      );  
    });
  &lt;/script&gt;&lt;script type=&quot;text/javascript&quot;&gt;
    (function () {
      if (Paged) {
        class PagedJsSizeWhisperer extends Paged.Handler {
          constructor(chunker, polisher, caller) {
            super(chunker, polisher, caller);
          }

          afterPreview(pages) {
            // Makes sure the pages container has the correct width
            // (by default pages container's width is all available space).
            const sheet = window.document.styleSheets[0];
            sheet.insertRule(
              &quot;.pagedjs_pages { width: fit-content; }&quot;,
              sheet.cssRules.length,
            );

            // Gets the container that contains all the pages
            // from the first element, since all pages share the same
            // &quot;super&quot; container.
            const firstPage = pages[0];

            if (!firstPage) {
              return;
            }

            const pagesArea = firstPage.pagesArea;
            const width = pagesArea.scrollWidth;
            const height = pagesArea.scrollHeight;

            window.top.postMessage({
              type: &quot;paged-js-size-whisperer&quot;,
              tag: &quot;main&quot;,
              height: height,
              width: width,
            });
          }
        }
        Paged.registerHandlers(PagedJsSizeWhisperer);
      }
    })();
  &lt;/script&gt;&lt;script type=&quot;text/javascript&quot;&gt;

          type: &quot;on-load-notifier&quot;,
          tag: &quot;main&quot;
        },

      )
    });

&lt;li data-ref=&quot;02863454-b5fc-452d-98c6-aa8013569944&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;1&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;2aadd99b-b9b5-4221-a2a8-0da84f6543db&quot;&gt;Dengan&lt;span&gt;&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;4000f99b-c72a-4d1d-a12b-fe41a14eef74&quot;&gt;menunjuk&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;61a1b76a-51e3-466f-9e74-49edff0fa8dc&quot;&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;ol data-ref=&quot;ff869889-9f5c-4bc4-af59-fd9a1d10a041&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; start=&quot;1&quot; style=&quot;list-style-type: lower-alpha; padding-left: 0px; box-sizing: border-box; padding-inline-start: 40px;&quot;&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;fe4ac5fa-a102-4db0-9186-4aeb41ffd1b3&quot; data-item-num=&quot;1&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;4f6938c4-d3ca-4b12-9c93-292dffed2ffb&quot;&gt;Surat Edaran Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko No. 07/DIR-1/0222 tanggal 09 Februari 2022 tentang Kebijakan Pelimpahan Dana Perusahaan&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;618483ca-4edb-42d1-9432-b1758a84eec1&quot; data-item-num=&quot;2&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem;&quot;&gt;NDE SVP Financial Operations and Business Partner No. C.Pos.55753/KU 100/KU01/2023 tanggal 24 Mei 2023 perihal Penerimaan Dana di KCU KC melalui Virtual Account BRI&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;NDE SVP Financial Operations and Business Partner No. C.Pos.56773/KU 100/KU01/2023 tanggal 29 Mei 2023 perihal Pelunasan Piutang di KCU/KC melalui Virtual Account BRI atau Bank&nbsp;Mandiri&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;618483ca-4edb-42d1-9432-b1758a84eec1&quot; data-item-num=&quot;2&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem;&quot;&gt;NDE VP Treasury and Tax No. C.Pos.37787/KU 100/KU0101/2023 tanggal 26 Maret 2023 perihal Pelimpahan Dana melalui Virtual Account Bank BNI&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Disampaikan bahwa evaluasi atas implementasi Pelimpahan Virtual Account (VA) di KCU Palopo pada bulan September 2025 sebesar&nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;96,15%&nbsp;&lt;/strong&gt;dengan jumlah kantor yang sudah menggunakan VA sebanyak 25 kantor dari 26 kantor antara lain sebagai berikut.&lt;img src=&quot;data:image/png;base64,&quot; alt=&quot;image.png&quot; style=&quot;max-width: 100%; height: auto;&quot; /&gt;-&lt;br /&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;data:image/png;base64,&quot; alt=&quot;image.png&quot; style=&quot;max-width: 100%; height: auto;&quot; /&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Berdasarkan dengan hal tersebut mohon agar dikonfirmasi:
&lt;ol style=&quot;padding-inline-start: 40px; list-style-type: lower-alpha;&quot;&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Kenapa masih terdapat kantor yang belum menggunakan VA?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Kenapa kantor yang sudah menggunakan VA namun jumlah transaksinya masih dibawah total hari kerja (perbankan)? sehingga terindikasi kantor tersebut tidak melaksanakan pelimpahan setiap hari.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Sehubungan dengan hal tersebut diinstruksikan kepada saudara untuk:
&lt;ol style=&quot;padding-inline-start: 40px; list-style-type: lower-alpha;&quot;&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;ce771704-feb9-44b3-ae62-9b5a02c2c620&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;2&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;494f378a-d537-42e8-a460-7d73df22adda&quot;&gt;Prioritaskan penggunaan virtual account untuk pengiriman remise KCP dan pelimpahan di KCU/KC karena &lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; color: #000000; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;&quot; data-ref=&quot;7f2304dd-5841-4b64-947b-739c7e056035&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;&lt;strong data-ref=&quot;884ff0de-d7fe-46f6-b762-b9861825bd46&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot;&gt;subtansi dari pengiriman remise di KCP bukan hanya sekedar menggugurkan kewajiban BM KCP mengirimkan remise ke KCU/KC, namun juga memastikan agar dana tersebut dapat dilimpahkan ke rekening Direktur Keuangan di Kantor Pusat pada hari yang sama&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; color: #000000; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;&quot; data-ref=&quot;600fe6bf-0c37-4500-aa01-9d14a759448f&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;ce771704-feb9-44b3-ae62-9b5a02c2c620&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;2&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;494f378a-d537-42e8-a460-7d73df22adda&quot;&gt;Pastikan pelimpahan di semua kantor dilakukan setiap hari.&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;0e03c143-21ef-4cf3-8a6f-8c503989fe42&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;&lt;strong data-ref=&quot;0c25f840-6390-4be7-958b-43038159a002&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot;&gt;”Tidak melampaui pagu kas”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;2203fdd6-fa54-495d-8925-c1d26d8711af&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;&lt;span&gt;&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;bukan menjadi alasan untuk tidak melakukan pelimpahan. Untuk KCP yang tidak melakukan pelimpahan/mengirimkan remise harian dengan alasan tidak melampaui pagu kas agar dievaluasi kembali pagu kas di KCP tersebut.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;ce771704-feb9-44b3-ae62-9b5a02c2c620&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;2&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;494f378a-d537-42e8-a460-7d73df22adda&quot;&gt;EGM/EM memastikan bahwa pelimpahan KCU/KC/KCP wajib dilakukan sebanyak 2x pada pagi hari sebelum jam 12.00 waktu setempat (atas transaksi penerimaan loket pada hari sebelumnya setelah perbankan tutup) dan pada akhir dinas sebelum perbankan tutup. Untuk KCP yang hanya terdiri dari 1 orang, pelimpahan dapat dilakukan 1x setiap hari agar tidak mengganggu jam pelayanan.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;59424be8-723e-48c3-ac05-4f0273a22bc4&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;4&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;EGM/EM mengevaluasi kembali pola pengiriman remise di KCU/KC serta KCP di wilayahnya&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;ea66bfda-d817-4c82-9141-9d5acf0fa7e9&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;&lt;span&gt;&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;khususnya pengiriman remise yang diantar tunai / melalui arpos. Apabila KCP tersebut dekat dan dapat menjangkau perbankan agar pengiriman remise diprioritaskan melalui perbankan.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box;&quot; data-ref=&quot;494f378a-d537-42e8-a460-7d73df22adda&quot;&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li data-ref=&quot;d3c9270f-9e58-4965-97f5-508cddaf2175&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot; data-item-num=&quot;6&quot; data-following=&quot;following-8511e7ae-b355-4a3a-be6f-91712be1e8bf&quot; style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 0.5rem; text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;EGM/EM memastikan dan mengevaluasi kembali di KCP yang tidak ada akses perbankan. Apabila terdapat lakupandai/agen perbankan&lt;span&gt;&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;0414c86e-ed3c-4fe0-a8b4-c1d19069de04&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;agar menggunakan agen&lt;span&gt;&nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;9ffe9541-3732-4cc2-a5b6-9a6a391ef33d&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;bank tersebut dengan terlebih dahulu berkomunikasi dan berkoordinasi dengan kami di regional.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 12pt;&quot; data-ref=&quot;ea66bfda-d817-4c82-9141-9d5acf0fa7e9&quot; data-undisplayed=&quot;undisplayed&quot;&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;
&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Konfimasi dan tindak lanjut atas evaluasi tersebut wajib kami terima maksimal 7 hari sejak NDE ini dikirimkan.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Demikian yang dapat disampaikan untuk dilaksanakan. Terima kasih atas perhatian dan kerjasamanya.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;
